headline: SEO & Content Strategy | B2B Client Consulting | Search Analytics
headline_rationale: Digital Reach needs SEO/content project execution, research, developer collaboration and client insights. Use supported SEO consulting, content/web work and agency measurement; do not invent link-building wins, technical audit portfolio or SaaS tenure.
summary: Search and content marketer combining SEO consulting with audience research, technical website work and agency client strategy. Consulted on on-page optimization, developed personalized content across web and email, and worked with development teams on site performance. Automated SERP and competitor analysis with Python and built reporting that turns campaign data into practical recommendations. B2B cross-functional experience and client account management support coordinated execution across content, web, analytics and commercial priorities.
factual_review: Read exact Digital Reach SEO Content Strategist contract job. E044/E114/E106/E113/E021/E023/E079/E076/E060 support all claims. No Ahrefs, digital PR/linkbuilding outcomes, specific indexation fixes or unsupported SaaS SEO case studies claimed.
tools_rationale: Source-backed search, analytical, CRM and web tooling; unsupported catalog labels are not introduced.
